rationale: The original image clearly shows a calcified granuloma in the right midlung. The change made was to negate the presence of this granuloma in the impression, creating an omission error. This aligns with the 'omission' category and specifically targets a quantitative finding (2 cm calcified granuloma) to create a false negative, as per the own_rules.
